thermalFit.limits: Thermal-model effective diameter/albedos, not axes, topographic radius/local normal, resolved geography, visible-colour pixels, local chemistry, porosity or independent thermophysical solution. Quoted errors retained as reported; complete systematic-error/covariance/previous-methods/raw-pipeline audit open; no new confidence-level interpretation.

observations.limits: Publisher rounded MJD/geometry retained without inventing individual UTCs/products or treating blank bands as zero flux. Cryogenic four-band observations and later post-cryogenicW1/W2 separate. These data do not identify/cross-calibrate the2007LORRI frames.

opticalPhaseAssumptions.limits: Preserve Table1±.01 versus section4.2±.02 source presentation; no silent correction. Section3 adopts G=.10±.15 for unmeasured phase functions and conservative .15mag H error. These are not Elara measured phase-function parameters; raw calibration and cited-method details not reproduced.

interpretations.roughness: Authors associate low eta with roughness/low thermal inertia; this is model interpretation, not measured crater/block sizes, mapped roughness or local grain chemistry.
interpretations.taxonomy: Authors C/P spectral-slope interpretation from albedos; not unique composition/local material fractions, direct origin/history or calibrated RGB. W1/W2 reflected-light dominated in their treatment.
interpretations.spin: Section4.2 W3 amplitude~.2mag over>24h; historical~.5mag and Luu~.1mag/aspect alternatives retained. No Elara period is derived here. Himalia Figure3/7.7819h period must not be assigned toElara. No pole, locking/permanentJupiterface or current spin-status claim.
interpretations.olderRadiometry: Section4.2 cites Cruikshank1977 diameter80±20km/albedo3±1percent; cited historical result only, original paper not independently inspected here.
interpretations.comparison: NASAoverview43km radius explicitly assumes.04albedo. Retain distinct from79.9±1.7km thermal effective DIAMETER; no silent catalogue replacement or claim they are identical quantities.
